comment: Only the modulation destination and amount carry a range in the code; the rise, fall, mix, invert and cycle controls fall back to Rack's default 0 to 1 with a default of 0. The two signal inputs carry whatever is patched into them, so they are given no family. The CYCLE switch reloops the CV envelope only after a trigger has started it: at rest the envelope's delta is zero and the branch that reloops it is never reached.
